artifacts.exit: Accept/Decline/Revoke persists a versioned local decision and returns to Settings/manual playback.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Decline or missing disclosure keeps Voice Manual Only and never affects local playback.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: No coercive countdown, preselection or repeated prompt; future change is user-initiated in Settings.
artifacts.accessibility: Cloud processing heading → purpose/destination/retention → Accept → Decline → Back.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: Consent UI is prohibited in active Driving Mode; immediately return to manual controls.

artifacts.entry: A valid active MediaSession exposes the platform notification surface.
artifacts.exit: Acknowledged command updates notification and app. Unavailable surface returns control to the app without fabricating stop.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Service owns queue/player/state and refreshes all app/system surfaces from one snapshot.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: A pending command is serialized; rejection/timeout refreshes truth before any safe retry.
artifacts.accessibility: Track/state → Previous → Play/Pause → Next → open app; pending/failure announced by the system.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: System controls do not auto-open Driving Mode.

artifacts.entry: Device locks or screen turns off while a valid MediaSession exists.
artifacts.exit: Unlock/app return reconnects to the complete current snapshot; surface absence is not playback failure.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Playback continues from service truth; commands remain pending until acknowledgement.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: Rejected/system-unavailable command refreshes state and restores reachable app controls.
artifacts.accessibility: Android owns focus order and labels; app documents only handoff, command and return.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: Lock-screen surface is never represented as an in-app Driving destination.

artifacts.entry: A supported Bluetooth/headset/vehicle media key issues a MediaSession command.
artifacts.exit: All visible surfaces refresh from the authoritative snapshot; unsupported/unavailable returns to app manual controls.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: The shared service validates, serializes and acknowledges the command.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: No optimistic duplicate command; safe retry only after refresh.
artifacts.accessibility: System controller labels are platform-owned; app feedback reflects acknowledged state only.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: A media-key command never auto-enters Driving Mode.

artifacts.entry: UI recreation, return from background, task/OEM event or controller loss.
artifacts.exit: Complete snapshot restores truthful Playing/Paused/Completed. Missing lifecycle may use validated P1 Paused Restore only.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Service remains authority for item, queue, state, position and supported actions.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: Repeated reconnect failure exposes Retry/Back; invalid restore routes to Library and never auto-plays.
artifacts.accessibility: Connecting status → Retry/Back → refreshed player state and actions.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: Driving reconnect keeps Exit enabled and never fabricates metadata or Playing.

artifacts.entry: Transient/permanent Audio Focus loss, call, duck request or focus callback error.
artifacts.exit: Valid transient gain may return to actual Playing; any failed guard or permanent loss remains Safe Paused with manual Resume.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Service pauses or ducks. Resume occurs only when all four guards pass and service acknowledges it.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: No hidden auto-retry. Manual Resume rechecks route/focus before command.
artifacts.accessibility: Interrupted/Paused status → manual Resume if safe → Exit; no unexpected speech or audio.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: Driving surface shows concise Interrupted/Safe Paused and fixed manual controls/Exit.

artifacts.entry: Wired/headset route disconnects or reconnects.
artifacts.exit: Reconnect rechecks route but never auto-resumes; explicit Play may resume after acknowledgement.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Service pauses at disconnect, cancels Voice and prevents speaker leakage.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: Manual Play is the only resume attempt; a new loss returns immediately to Safe Paused.
artifacts.accessibility: Route disconnected → Safe Paused → route available → explicit Play/Exit.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: Driving Mode remains one layer with Safe Paused, manual Play and Exit.

artifacts.entry: Selected/current Bluetooth output route disconnects or reconnects.
artifacts.exit: Reconnect produces Safe Paused. Explicit manual Play revalidates route and waits for service acknowledgement.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Service immediately pauses on loss, invalidates the route and prevents speaker fallback leakage.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: No automatic Resume. Failed manual Play stays Safe Paused with Exit/manual controls.
artifacts.accessibility: Bluetooth disconnected → Safe Paused → reconnected → explicit Play/Exit.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: No suggestion/setup during active recovery; fixed Play and Exit remain reachable.

artifacts.entry: The first explicit Voice attempt settles as timeout/no-match/provider/language/network/audio failure.
artifacts.exit: Retry starts attempt two. Any second failure immediately dismisses to fixed manual controls; a new session needs a new mic tap.
artifacts.sourceOfTruth: Underlying Playback Service state remains unchanged unless a command was acknowledged.
artifacts.emptyErrorDenialRetry: Exactly one explicit Retry; no third attempt, countdown coercion or Settings detour.
artifacts.accessibility: Failure reason → Retry once → Manual controls → Exit; focus returns to the initiating control.
artifacts.drivingRestriction: Manual Previous/Play-Pause/Next/Seek Back and Exit are immediately reachable after failure.
